text:
Alex J: Hey all — first day! I just tried to open Redwood Console (staging) and I get a permissions error: "You are not authorized to view this page". Who should I ping for access?

onboarding-bot: Welcome Alex :tada: To get Console access, open the internal Access Requests page (https://internal.redwood.company/access). Select 'Console - Staging' or 'Console - Prod' and include your manager + reason. If you need temporary elevated rights mention 'onboarding: first-week'.

Sara M: @Alex J I can help. For staging I usually just add folks to the `redwood-console-staging-read` group via the access portal. If you need to hit admin panels or toggle feature flags you'll need `redwood-console-admins` or `feature-flags-admins` — those require manager approval.

Alex J: Thanks Sara. Quick q — is there a way to check which groups I'm already in?

Vikram R: run `okta whoami --groups` or look at your Okta profile > Groups. If the CLI is easier: `okta-cli profile groups` shows SCIM-sync'd groups.

Irene: I can temporarily add you to `redwood-console-staging-admins` for 24h if you need to click around and set up routes/flags. @Alex J confirm and tell me what you need to do.

Alex J: Would be great to have staging admin for now to validate a few feature flags and check routing policies. Thanks Irene!

infra-team: Filed request infra-3429 on your behalf for the prod read access, @Alex J — link: https://infra.redwood.company/tickets/infra-3429. Prod admin still needs manager + security review; staging admin granted by Irene as discussed.

Sara M: Also FYI, feature flag mutations are audited. Use the /ff UI in Console or the CLI `rw-ff toggle --env staging --flag my_flag --on` and add a short audit note.

Alex J: Perfect — thanks everyone. One last thing: where's the short onboarding checklist for Console tasks?

onboarding-bot: Checklist link: https://internal.redwood.company/onboarding/new-hire-console-checklist. Steps: verify groups, request staging admin if needed, run smoke tests against staging endpoints, add yourself to monitoring oncall for alerts.

Alex J: Got it. I'm unblocked. :raised_hands:
